subject: Queue refinement: natural action clips; lip-sync remains separate R&D
body: Latest direct Ziggy clarification: he edits complete music videos without sung/lip-synced lyrics and cuts around talking. Prioritize existing story/action footage with natural expressions, explicitly excluding unintended dialogue/singing/mouthing unless assigned. Exact master-vocal performance and mouth/grill temporal proof remain separate R&D, not a base-clip gate. Generated speech is not proof of song timing/melody/adlibs; Comfy remains possible/unproven. Hon's actor-transformation/final-identity release hold is NOT waived. This starts no additional job. Attached append-only refinement qualifies the ready queue without changing prior files. At the next compatible checkpoint, carry this with the consolidated Chief priority relay and existing-shot proposals; dog test remains current first priority.

attachments.description: Latest user clarification: base action clips versus separate lip-sync R&D and preserved Hon hold
